title: VOYAGER: Feature Film
description:
In 1977 NASA launched an unprecedented 40-year mission sending two probes to the

farthest reaches of our Solar System, Voyager 1 and Voyager 2. It's now 2152 and instead

of probes, NASA are sending two families to endure what will be humanity’s greatest test

- to achieve inter-generational survival in space. The whole world is watching as the

families draw on their training to survive the complexities of space exploration, before an

unforeseen set of circumstances drive the families apart, culminating in a catastrophic

event that threatens to jeopardise to whole mission. VOYAGER is a Sci-Fi Thriller laced

with twists, turns and simmering with tension.


Available materials: Script, Pitch Deck / Treatment.
